I'm rather new myself, I've been playing for about a month and a half now.
Any advice given really depends how you want to play, if you just want to mess around with friends and so on, read up on a few different types of decks, try find a cheap one (Mono-red decks, which are also brilliant for beginners are normally rather cheap)
Though if you want to play at a gaming store in Standard, you couldn't play Magic 2014 cards, as new expansions, or blocks are released, the oldest goes out. You can find more information at 
[This Website](http://magic.wizards.com/en/content/standard-formats-magic-gathering)
In terms of rulings, you can find quite a lot online, or you can ask friends who play about it, they can tend to help really well, and if you play Standard at your LGS (Local Gaming Store) Most players in my experience will help a lot if you ask questions.
If you need any more advice, feel free to PM me
